Pine Crossing is the store. I've posted that as a reply to your message in #central-team.

It's from your own message there on 9 June: the morning receiver at Pine Crossing said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver had turned up at 7:10 and they wrote his trailer number on a sticky note.

I couldn't find an address or site code for Pine Crossing in anything you can see. If the sheet needs more than the store name, Hollis's shift-template check or the store ops list may have it.
